$comment: Hand-maintained map from runtime source files to architecture modules. The first matching rule wins. `npm run atlas` warns about every runtime file that no rule matches, and the knowledge rules fail on a path that no longer exists. A description says what the module does, checked against its code; it is shown in the map and to agents through MCP.

clusters.title: API server core
clusters.description: Hono app and server entry points, request context, tRPC procedure builders and the root router.

clusters.title: tRPC routers and HTTP sub-apps
clusters.description: One file per router mounted in api/router.ts, plus the SMS Hono sub-app mounted in api/boot.ts.

clusters.title: Authentication and sessions
clusters.description: Password hashing, JWT session creation, session validation and login brute-force protection.

clusters.title: Request security
clusters.description: Rate limiting, allowed origins, client IP resolution, ownership checks, upload signature checks, bot protection and security logging.

clusters.title: Platform services
clusters.description: Environment validation, Redis client and cache keys, system settings, business time zone helpers, scheduled-job locks and error logging.

clusters.title: Database schema and access
clusters.description: Drizzle schema, relations, storage classes and the MySQL connection pool.

clusters.title: Shared contracts
clusters.description: Types, limits and billing plans shared by the web app and the API.

clusters.title: Billing
clusters.description: Paymob checkout requests, webhook verification settings and the subscription grant that sets a user's plan.

clusters.title: Ledger aggregates
clusters.description: Daily expense rollups (the delta applied inside every expense write, and reconciliation against the ledger), the expense_details side table, and salary-cycle month ranges.

clusters.title: Account lifecycle
clusters.description: Account deletion: purgeUserData removes every row a user owns, inside the caller's transaction.

clusters.title: Scheduled job bodies
clusters.description: Job implementations scheduled from api/boot.ts.

clusters.title: Notifications
clusters.description: Web push (VAPID) and Firebase Cloud Messaging delivery, scheduled and event-triggered notifications, budget alerts, activity nudges and the default templates.

clusters.title: WhatsApp
clusters.description: Baileys WhatsApp client and the in-process OTP state it verifies against.

clusters.title: Voice
clusters.description: Live voice calls: a WebSocket bridged to the Gemini Live API, with session checks, voice quotas, tools that draft actions, the financial context for the call and the call archive.

clusters.title: AI provider access
clusters.description: Provider clients, the provider registry, model name mapping, routing and fallback chains.

clusters.title: AI usage and cost governance
clusters.description: Per-plan token limits and per-request caps, burst counting, AI cost metrics and the admin cost overview, and the check of model-written numbers against facts.

clusters.title: Arabic and Egyptian text processing
clusters.description: Normalizers, dictionaries, Arabic number parsing, negation detection, fuzzy matching and speech-to-text corrections.

clusters.title: Ingestion parsers
clusters.description: Bank SMS parsing (rules first, then an AI parser with a per-user cache), receipt parsing with a vision model, and the generator of the personal iOS Shortcut.

clusters.title: Classification benchmark helpers
clusters.description: Helpers used only by the classification benchmark and QA scripts: taxonomy assertions and simulated users.

clusters.title: Expense classification pipeline
clusters.description: smart-pipeline.ts and the modules it composes: financial events, admissibility, rules, muscle memory, embeddings, taxonomy, confidence calibration, decomposition, verification and the final per-item acceptance.

clusters.title: AI Center kernel
clusters.description: Plans each AI Center turn without a model (intent, data needs, clarifying questions), packs the context, applies the capability registry and retrieval policy, words the answer with at most one model call, and logs traces.

clusters.title: AI action runtime
clusters.description: Actions the assistant proposes, such as recording an expense, updating a wallet or creating a goal: stored as pending drafts and executed only after the user confirms, with the artifacts shown in chat.

clusters.title: AI memory
clusters.description: Long-term memory about each user: conversation capsules and running summaries, extracted facts, embeddings and backfill, and retrieval from Qdrant or a quantized local vector store.

clusters.title: Finance semantic layer
clusters.description: Answers factual finance questions from the ledger: period resolution, category matching, row aggregation, monthly report facts, proactive insights, chart artifacts and a per-user cache.

clusters.title: Site guide
clusters.description: How-to answers about using SmartSpend (linking SMS, cards and wallets, goals, reports) from a built-in knowledge base with embedding retrieval.

clusters.title: File storage
clusters.description: File storage behind one driver interface (local disk or S3-compatible storage such as R2), plus the avatar service.

clusters.title: AI insights and reports
clusters.description: Personalization: the smart profile, onboarding questions, lifestyle inference and behaviour snapshots, personal context for prompts, Pro report building and Gemini batch jobs.

clusters.title: Web app shell
clusters.description: Entry point, providers, layout, route guards and PWA or native integration.

clusters.title: Web pages
clusters.description: Route-level page components lazy-loaded by src/App.tsx.

clusters.title: UI primitives
clusters.description: shadcn and Radix UI primitives in src/components/ui/.

clusters.title: Admin UI
clusters.description: Admin console tabs: ads, audit log, raw SMS, learned rules, settings, WhatsApp, clarifications, notifications and the AI Center administration.

clusters.title: AI Center UI
clusters.description: AI Center screens: the chatbot, the AI memory manager, the monthly AI report and the live voice call.

clusters.title: Finance UI
clusters.description: Home dashboard (summaries, calendar, charts, search, streaks), expense entry with receipt capture, recent expenses, goals and AI insights.

clusters.title: Account UI
clusters.description: Biometric lock and passkeys, the smart profile, business and people settings, SMS webhook settings, bank sync setup for Android and iOS, and the push prompt.

clusters.title: Ads and SEO UI
clusters.description: The ad banner and SEO meta tags.

clusters.title: Shared web components
clusters.description: Shell components at the root of src/components: sidebar, notification bell, onboarding card, product tour and loading skeleton.

clusters.title: Web hooks
clusters.description: React hooks for auth, admin, plan and ads data, push notifications, PWA lifecycle, biometrics, navigation, keyboard and haptics.

clusters.title: Web utilities
clusters.description: Client utilities (back-button handling, biometric auth, client rules engine, image compression, financial taxonomy, query persistence, transaction display), src/types and loose files at the root of src/.
